messages:
ops-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: hosted-api (us-west) p95/p99 latency spike detected. Request queue x4 in 8m. KV prefix cache miss rate jumped to ~92%. Autoscaler attempts failing. Pagerduty triggered.
maya: ack. I'm on it. Seeing model=redwood-13B-opt hot prefixes, p95 from 2.4s -> 8.1s. Starting immediate mitigation. Paging @ryan.
ryan: joining. Any customers impacted right now? Ideas: fallback to quantized variant or reduce token limits per request.
customer-success: multiple customers getting 504s and timeouts for chat/embeddings. Logged INC-3789, some seats reporting 5-10% error rate since 12:10pm.
maya: plan: 1) apply short-term admission control (max_tokens=512) 2) enable prefix-dedupe and warmup 3) try autoscaler leader failover. Applying (1) now.
maya: ```
# push route admission control
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.internal/routes/update \
  -d '{"route":"/generate","max_tokens":512,"soft_reject":true}'
``` 
infra-bot: rollout started for route change (cfg-id: cfg-2026-09-12-01). Will auto-rollback in 10m if error.
ryan: attempted scale up via provisioner -> error: 
```text
provisioner.create_pool(...) -> error: QuotaExceeded: GPU quota request denied for project: hosted-production (limit 0)
``` 
sean: autoscaler leader heartbeat lagging, observed leader restart 2m ago. I'll attempt leader restart / failover.
maya: initiating leader restart now.
ops-bot: Autoscaler leader restart requested by sean. ETA ~45s.
sean: leader restarted. Post-restart logs show a backfill loop stuck on prefix warmup keys:
```text
ERROR backfill: keyset=1.8M items, mem=98%, iterate stuck for 00:02:14
``` 
ryan: hypothesis: sudden customer campaign created thousands of new prefixes (unique prompt starts) and bypassed client-side caching -> KV cache never warms, resulting in extra GPU decode work and memory churn. Recommend enabling prefix-dedupe + rate-limit new prefix cardinality and allow autoscaler to catch up.
maya: enabling prefix-dedupe flag across edge and infra nodes now.
infra-bot: prefix-dedupe toggled=ON across edges (rollout-id: rd-qual-332). Observability: cache-miss rate dropping to ~67% from 92% within 7m.
customer-success: reports improving metrics from customers, most 504s resolved; one enterprise customer still saw a 504 at 12:28pm — CS following up.
maya: handing incident to @ryan for monitoring and postmortem. I'm stepping off the rotation.
ryan: taking over. I'll keep watch for 2h, open a follow-up runbook to request increased GPU quota for hosted-production and add prefix-warmup in onboarding docs. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: Incident update: queue length back to baseline and p95/p99 trending toward normal after admission control + prefix-dedupe + autoscaler restart. Marking incident as degraded -> resolving. :white_check_mark:
